en.shortDescription: GraphHopper routing engine for Nextcloud Maps
en.longDescription:
Nextcloud Maps companion that runs a self-hosted GraphHopper routing server for the Nextcloud Maps app.

Default extract is Andorra via NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_PBF_URL (change to your Geofabrik region and raise NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_JAVA_OPTS for larger areas). In Nextcloud Administration → Additional settings → Maps, set the GraphHopper URL to SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_MAPS.

de.longDescription:
Nextcloud-Maps-Begleitdienst mit selbst gehostetem GraphHopper-Routing-Server für die Nextcloud-Maps-App.

Standard-Extrakt ist Andorra über NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_PBF_URL (auf deine Geofabrik-Region ändern und NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_JAVA_OPTS für größere Gebiete erhöhen). Unter Nextcloud Administration → Zusätzliche Einstellungen → Maps die GraphHopper-URL auf SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_MAPS setzen.

fr.shortDescription: Moteur de routage GraphHopper pour Nextcloud Maps
fr.longDescription:
Companion Nextcloud Maps qui exécute un serveur de routage GraphHopper auto-hébergé pour l'app Maps.

L'extrait par défaut est Andorre via NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_PBF_URL (changez pour votre région Geofabrik et augmentez NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_JAVA_OPTS pour de plus grandes zones). Dans Nextcloud Administration → Paramètres supplémentaires → Maps, définissez l'URL GraphHopper sur SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_MAPS.

pt.shortDescription: Motor de rotas GraphHopper para Nextcloud Maps
pt.longDescription:
Companion do Nextcloud Maps com um servidor de rotas GraphHopper auto-hospedado para a app Maps.

O extrato padrão é Andorra via NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_PBF_URL (altere para a sua região Geofabrik e aumente NEXTCLOUD_MAPS_JAVA_OPTS para áreas maiores). Em Nextcloud Administração → Definições adicionais → Maps, defina o URL do GraphHopper para SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_MAPS.
